prompt:
The graph below shows how much electricity was generated from four sources in one country between 1995 and 2025.

Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.
instruction_line: You should spend about 20 minutes on this task. Write at least 150 words.

visual.title: Electricity generated by source, 1995-2025
visual.alt: A line chart showing the change between 1995 and 2025 in electricity generated from coal, natural gas, hydropower, and wind and solar in one country.

key_points: Coal falls throughout (120 → 22 TWh) and drops from a clear first place in 1995 to last place in 2025 — the largest decline of all
Wind and solar rise from 2 TWh to 120 TWh; the smallest source at the start becomes the largest by 2025 — the fastest growth of all
Natural gas grows rapidly at first, peaking at 80 TWh in 2020, then falls back slightly (74 TWh)
Hydropower barely changes (45 → 51 TWh); it falls from second place in 1995 to third place in 2025
There are several crossover points: wind and solar overtake hydropower around 2010, coal between 2015 and 2020, and natural gas between 2020 and 2025
Total output rises (from around 197 TWh to 267 TWh), and the mix of sources becomes far more balanced than it was
common_mistakes: Reading the four series year by year and not writing an overview paragraph
Inventing a reason ('coal plants were closed by the government') — the chart gives no reasons
Describing the peak and the fall that follows it (natural gas, 2020) as if it were a one-way rise
Not mentioning the series that stays almost flat (hydropower) at all
Confusing terawatt hours with a percentage share — the chart gives quantities, not shares
